description: Source code implementing inverse discrete cosine transform (IDCT) functions for video decoding, including functions for IDCT on macroblocks, intra blocks, and related utilities, with specific optimizations for fast IDCT.

methods.name: MBlockIDCT
methods.description: Performs IDCT on macroblock data within a video decoding context.

methods.name: BlockIDCT_intra
methods.description: Performs IDCT on intra macroblock blocks, with optimizations for fast IDCT.

methods.name: Copy_Blk_to_Vop
methods.description: Copies prediction block to video output buffer.

methods.name: BlockIDCT
methods.description: Performs IDCT and adds prediction to output block, with multiple implementation options.

methods.name: idctrow
methods.description: Performs IDCT on a row of coefficients, with intra and non-intra variants.

methods.name: idctcol
methods.description: Performs IDCT on a column of coefficients.
